body.x: GDU introduced a GPS sensor type drone ‘Byrd’ at ‘CES 2018 Unveiled’ held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. on Sunday, Jan. 7th.

Byrd is a drone made of military materials that can fly perfectly in any environment. This product features a state-of-the-art battery function and a powerful propulsion system for stable flight and is easy to fold and use, making it portable. Byrd’s gimbal system works with 1080p camera, 4k camera, GoPro, infrared camera and handful elite DSLR and small cameras.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
